system.description:
Memory Delve: Make an Interface Roll
against a target within Far range. Ona
success, peer into the target’s mind,
memory archive, neural residue, or
recorded perception and ask the GM a
question. The GM describes any
memories the target has pertaining to
the answer.
Neural Loadshare: Once per long rest,
spend a Hope to choose two willing
creatures. You create a temporary
neural support link between them.
When one of them would mark Stress,
they can choose between the two of
them who marks it. This protocol lasts
until their next rest.
